_doc: fleet-bootcheck's settings: copy to /etc/fleet-bootcheck.json (or point FLEET_BOOTCHECK_CONFIG at it). hermes: the hermes launcher; notify: a command that takes one message argument; logdir + breadcrumb: the file a deliberate reboot leaves ({"packages": ...}); live_switch: a file that arms checks_live (absent = checks_legacy). Check kinds: http (url), port (TCP LISTEN), unit (system manager), user_unit (the unit's user manager, plus an optional health url); tries and nap per check. Empty checks = it confirms nothing and says 'All 0 services green'. `_reference_install` is the machine krew was built on, verbatim except the home path, an agent name and a dev-box port (placeholders in <>); nothing reads it.
